mapper.select: select dept_id from sys_dept where dept_id = #{deptId} or find_in_set(#{deptId}, ancestors)

select distinct d.dept_id from sys_user_shop us inner join sys_dept scope_dept on scope_dept.dept_id = us.dept_id inner join sys_dept d on ( d.dept_id = scope_dept.dept_id or find_in_set(scope_dept.dept_id, d.ancestors) ) where us.user_id = #{userId} and scope_dept.del_flag = '0' and scope_dept.status = '0' and scope_dept.dept_type in ('GROUP', 'COMPANY', 'STORE', 'WAREHOUSE') and d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' and d.dept_type = 'STORE' order by d.parent_id, d.order_num

select authorized.dept_id from ( select distinct d.dept_id, d.parent_id, d.order_num from sys_user_shop us inner join sys_dept scope_dept on scope_dept.dept_id = us.dept_id inner join sys_dept d on ( d.dept_id = scope_dept.dept_id or find_in_set(scope_dept.dept_id, d.ancestors) ) where us.user_id = #{userId} and scope_dept.del_flag = '0' and scope_dept.status = '0' and scope_dept.dept_type in ('GROUP', 'COMPANY', 'STORE', 'WAREHOUSE') and d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' and d.dept_type in ('STORE', 'WAREHOUSE') ) authorized order by authorized.parent_id, authorized.order_num, authorized.dept_id
select d.dept_id from sys_dept d where d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' and d.dept_type in ('STORE', 'WAREHOUSE') order by d.parent_id, d.order_num
select dept_name from sys_dept where dept_id = #{deptId} and del_flag = '0' limit 1

select le.legal_entity_id, le.legal_entity_code, le.legal_entity_name, le.unified_social_credit_code, le.registered_address, le.legal_representative, le.contact_phone, candidate.dept_id as source_dept_id, candidate.dept_name as source_dept_name from sys_dept source inner join sys_dept candidate on candidate.dept_id = source.dept_id or find_in_set(candidate.dept_id, source.ancestors) inner join sys_legal_entity le on le.legal_entity_id = candidate.legal_entity_id where source.dept_id = #{deptId} and source.del_flag = '0' and candidate.del_flag = '0' and source.status = '0' and candidate.status = '0' and le.status = '0' order by case when candidate.dept_id = source.dept_id then 999999 else find_in_set(candidate.dept_id, source.ancestors) end desc limit 1

select legal_entity_id, legal_entity_code, legal_entity_name, unified_social_credit_code, registered_address, legal_representative, contact_phone, status, version from sys_legal_entity where status = '0' order by legal_entity_name asc, legal_entity_id asc

select legal_entity_id, legal_entity_code, legal_entity_name, unified_social_credit_code, registered_address, legal_representative, contact_phone, status, version from sys_legal_entity where legal_entity_id = #{legalEntityId} and status = '0'
select count(1) from sys_dept where dept_id = #{targetDeptId} and (dept_id = #{scopeDeptId} or find_in_set(#{scopeDeptId}, ancestors))

select count(1) from sys_user_shop us inner join sys_dept scope_dept on scope_dept.dept_id = us.dept_id inner join sys_dept target_dept on target_dept.dept_id = #{deptId} where us.user_id = #{userId} and scope_dept.del_flag = '0' and scope_dept.status = '0' and scope_dept.dept_type in ('GROUP', 'COMPANY', 'STORE', 'WAREHOUSE') and target_dept.del_flag = '0' and target_dept.status = '0' and target_dept.dept_type = 'STORE' and ( target_dept.dept_id = scope_dept.dept_id or find_in_set(scope_dept.dept_id, target_dept.ancestors) )
select count(1) from sys_dept where dept_id = #{deptId} and del_flag = '0' and status = '0' and dept_type = 'STORE'
